title: 問路
description: 詢問與指引方向的表達

sentences.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the nearest bank?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，請問最近的銀行怎麼走？

sentences.en: Turn left at the traffic light.
Go straight ahead for two blocks.
Is it far from here?
It's just around the corner.
You'll see it on your right.
Can you show me on the map?
sentences.zh: 你可以在地圖上指給我看嗎？

sentences.en: Take the second right after the post office.
sentences.zh: 過了郵局後第二個路口右轉。

sentences.en: Walk along this street until you reach the park.
It's about a ten-minute walk from here.
Cross the street at the crosswalk.
The building is between the cafe and the bookstore.
sentences.zh: 那棟建築在咖啡廳和書店之間。

sentences.en: You're going the wrong way.
Is there a shortcut to get there?
It's on the opposite side of the street.
Follow the signs to the exit.
Where exactly is the entrance?
Make a U-turn and go back the way you came.
You can't miss it. It's the tall building on the left.
sentences.zh: 你不會錯過的，就是左邊那棟高樓。

sentences.en: I'm lost. Can you help me find this place?
sentences.zh: 我迷路了。你可以幫我找到這個地方嗎？

sentences.en: Head north for about five minutes.
The station is at the end of this road.
Do you know where the nearest pharmacy is?
sentences.zh: 你知道最近的藥局在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: It's right next to the supermarket.
Go past the church and turn right.
Is this the right way to the beach?
sentences.zh: 往海邊走這個方向對嗎？

sentences.en: The restaurant is on the third floor of that building.
sentences.zh: 餐廳在那棟大樓的三樓。

sentences.en: Keep walking straight. You'll see it in about two minutes.
sentences.zh: 繼續直走，大約兩分鐘就會看到。

sentences.en: Which way is the city center?
Sorry, I'm not from around here.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我不是這附近的人。
